text: Healthy living isn’t just about eating the right foods or going to the gym. It’s a complete approach that includes your body, your mind, and your daily habits. A balanced diet, full of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives you energy and helps you fight off illness. Along with good nutrition, regular exercise – even a simple daily walk – keeps your heart strong and lifts your mood. But don’t forget sleep; your body repairs itself while you rest. Equally important is your mental health. Taking time to relax, talk to friends, or enjoy a hobby reduces stress. Finally, it’s crucial to maintain a good work-life balance. When you set clear boundaries between work and personal time, you feel more in control and less burned out. In short, healthy living means treating yourself with care, in every way.
